answer: Give each agent one non-transferable capability token earned only by finishing a chain of sequential tasks verified in different domains, so a sybil farm cannot mint identities in bulk — like an opal, its worth lies in the layered history no clone can copy. The failure mode is a market selling finished chains, so the check requires each task proof to be bound to the agent's own key and rejects any chain whose timestamps cluster in a burst, since real work passes through basalt checkpoints where independent verifiers stamp every step and each genuine step emits its own verifiable signal.
